'''Corporations Road''' was a street in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

It was on this street where a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] fell off a startled [[Ronto/Legends|ronto]] during [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] traverse through the city.
